children: A newly created account bought $482,000 in bets on BetBoom Team to defeat Team Falcons in the CS2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026 semifinal. According to Odaily, the account, identified as 0x57a85952044f2c8e4d31b475aab6987d2f98ebc2, entered at an average price of 28.2 cents and purchased 1,714,477.9 shares. The best-of-three match is scheduled to start at 1:00 on October 18, with the winner advancing to the final.

title: New Account Buys $482,000 Bet on BetBoom to Beat Falcons at CS2 Thunderpick World Championship 2026
